scope: All commits reachable from local refs via --all; every commit tree path inspected; eligible normal UTF-8 source and exact .env.example blobs pattern-scanned once

gitFsck.meaning: Connectivity only; does not prove absence of secrets, ownership, human authorship, contribution or permission to publish

sharingConclusion: Not cleared for public sharing; protected paths and pattern matches require owner review without printing secret values; pattern absence is not a guarantee
nextActions: Do not publish or push based solely on this scan
Owner reviews each finding and protected path locally without exposing values
If real credentials occurred, revoke or rotate through approved separate action; do not rewrite history without authorization
Keep existing private data excluded; prepare separate reviewer access only with authorization
